reason: With R_pred held fixed while observed video labels are permuted, P(R_perm - R_pred >= R_obs - R_pred) = P(R_perm >= R_obs): algebraically identical to the ordinary R_I permutation test, so it does NOT independently test whether observed imagery reliability exceeds predicted cue/video contamination.

fallback_spec.procedure: PAIRED hierarchical bootstrap: the SAME imagery-session split + resample realization is applied to BOTH observed and cue/video-predicted imagery betas (never independent bootstraps); predicted signal carries EXACTLY zero true-imagery contribution
fallback_spec.statistic: Delta_b = R_obs_b - R_pred_b on matched resampled units
fallback_spec.criterion: Delta_I point > 0 AND paired bootstrap 95% CI lower > 0 AND Delta_I > 0 under every sealed split-seed
fallback_spec.primary_R_I_unchanged: primary R_I keeps its original frozen permutation p-value; no nominal Delta permutation p produced (no joint randomization proof)
